visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of a pink cast-iron pot filled with ginger and tofu skin mixed rice. A white rice spatula is stirring the steaming rice. Yellow and red text overlays are present. (2) A shot of a plated meal with scallion stir-fried chicken and the mixed rice on a white Hello Kitty themed plate. (3) Hands wash white rice in a metal strainer over a bowl. Clear water is poured over the rice, and fingers agitate the grains. (4) A small teal pot on an induction stove contains water and a broth bag. Salt and liquid seasonings are added. (5) On a yellow cutting board, hands use a kitchen knife to slice fresh ginger into thin sheets and then into fine matchsticks. (6) Two sheets of fried tofu skin are sliced in half and then into strips on the same board. (7) The soaked rice is poured into a large pink cast-iron pot on an induction cooktop. Dark seasoned broth is poured in, followed by ginger and tofu strips. (8) The lid is placed on the pink pot. Steam rises as the rice cooks. (9) The lid is lifted to reveal the cooked rice. A spatula fluffs the grains, showing the texture. (10) A female creator with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt and pink apron, takes a large bite of the food from the Hello Kitty plate, closing her eyes in enjoyment and gesturing with her hands to show it's delicious.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM. A female narrator speaks in a friendly, clear tone. A subtle 'pop' sound effect occurs as text appears. (2) As the video shows rice washing, the sound of splashing water and grains rubbing against a strainer is audible, mixed with the ongoing narration. (3) A distinct mechanical 'click' is heard when salt is added and the stove is operated. The narration continues to explain the broth-making process. (4) Rhythmic, crisp sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board accompany the ginger and tofu slicing scenes. (5) A 'clink' sound occurs as a glass jar is placed on the table. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (6) The sound of the lid clattering onto the cast iron pot and the faint hiss of steam are audible. The narrator's voice rises in pitch excitedly as the rice is finished. (7) Towards the end, a subtle 'crunch' and swallowing sound can be heard as the creator tastes the meal, followed by enthusiastic verbal expressions of delight.
